name: metrologybase
description: MetrologyBase — practical tools, resources, and vendor-neutral buying guidance for calibration professionals.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx serve dist
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/pressure-gauges dist/products && cp index.html articles.html products.html pressure-gauges.html full-scale-vs-full-span.html pressure-adapters-and-fittings.html pressure-gauge-accuracy-0-05-vs-0-1.html what-pressure-fittings-for-10000-psi.html what-pressure-fittings-for-60000-psi.html styles.css app.js search.js dist/ && cp pressure-gauges/*.html pressure-gauges/device.css pressure-gauges/device.js dist/pressure-gauges/ && cp products/*.html products/device.css dist/products/ && cp -R public/. dist/ && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs
